scripts.setup:local: pnpm install && pnpm run db:create && pnpm run db:push && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter ./backend run build && pnpm --filter ./frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./backend" --filter "./frontend" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
